note: R0 flesh runtime settings for a woman about 28, from tissue-research/flesh-dynamics-r0.md. Every value names its source; STAND-IN marks a compartment with no data of its own. Tensed frequency = relaxed x 1.4 (active/passive frequency ratio 1.17-1.40, Christensen 2023, upper end = full activation); tensed damping = relaxed x 1.3 (pre-activation raised damping 25-30 %, Zhang 2019). Most vibration data are male or mixed (see the research file).
bulge_source: front thigh thickness +20 % rest to max contraction (Chauhan 2013 [M]; Sekir 2022 [mixed]); one value for every muscle in R0 (calf can reach +40 %, side of thigh ~0 %)

quadriceps.source: 8-11 Hz relaxed (Wakeling & Nigg 2001 via Friesenbichler 2013 [mixed]); 13.8-14.2 Hz in landing (Zhang 2019 [M]); zeta 0.12-0.16 converted from Zhang 2019 decay rates

hamstrings.source: 16-20 Hz in landing, taken as tensed (Zhang 2019 [M]); relaxed = tensed / 1.4; zeta 0.08-0.11 converted from Zhang 2019

calf.source: 10.5 +- 2.7 Hz in running (Behling 2021 [mixed, 27 y]); zeta reported 0.1-0.7, low end taken (0.66 is a running-fit upper bound) - UNCERTAIN

adductors.source: STAND-IN: quadriceps values (no adductor data found)

gluteals.source: STAND-IN: quadriceps values (no buttock wobble data found)
